---
title: "Racial Demographics in Sarasota County Over Time"
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

This animated map explores changes in the spatial distribution of the Black population across Sarasota County, Florida across the 2000, 2010, and 2020 Decennial Censuses.

Throughout all three decades, the Black population has remained heavily concentrated in North Sarasota (Newtown), while the vast majority of other tracts across the county have remained under 2% Black.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(gganimate)

# Load the multi-year tract data and calculate percentage of Black residents
sarasota <- readRDS("data/sarasota_race.rds") |>
  mutate(
    pct_black = 100 * black / total,
    year = as.integer(year)
  )

# Build the animated map cycling through census years
anim <- ggplot(sarasota) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = pct_black), color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "plasma",
    labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1),
    name = "% Black",
    limits = c(0, 100)
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(
    title = "Sarasota County: Black Population by Census Tract",
    subtitle = "Decennial Census Year: {current_frame}",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau (2000, 2010, 2020)"
  ) +
  transition_manual(year)

animate(
  anim,
  fps = 1,
  width = 600,
  height = 500,
  units = "px",
  renderer = gifski_renderer()
)
```
